decision: Retain the original corrected SparkRing/RoCEnante+NCCL recipe. The SIRCL image passed functional and finite fidelity screens but showed no consistent decode gain; MXFP8 and larger buffers are not selected.
preserved: Adaptive 8K/4K scheduling and guarded TP indexer
HF tokenizer, DSpark5, existing NVFP4 draft head and Markov
GPU upper ceiling 2350 MHz, minimum 0 on all ranks
protocol: Installed LIL v0.6.2 and original matched wrapper; 30-second sustained cells; temperature 1, top_p 1, top_k -1, thinking false, max output 2048.
scope: Focused 8K/128K C1/C8/C16 screen. Not a full-grid benchmark.
limitations: Short stochastic measurements without confidence intervals.
The 128K prefill screen has one sample per arm; 8K has five.
Output throughput depends on draft acceptance; verification-step rates also reflect adaptive draft work and are not a pure hardware control.
New image changes vLLM/B12x and transport together; baseline differences do not isolate SIRCL.
Known answers and finite top-20 distribution comparisons are not proof of universal equivalent quality.

mxfp8_configuration.note: Scoped backend required for this image. Global linear backend left auto. Draft head stays NVFP4.
